summary: Completed backend API regression and mobile browser flow testing for registration, profile personalization, food scan, medicine scan, history, and result navigation.

minor.issue: Frontend API client reads VITE_API_URL instead of the required REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; current same-origin proxy masks this, but production external API configuration can fail.
Passwords use PBKDF2-SHA256 rather than the requested bcrypt ($2b$) format, and no five-failure brute-force lockout is implemented.

action_items: Switch frontend API base URL to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL while preserving the configured environment contract.
Use bcrypt password hashes and add the documented brute-force lockout behavior.
Add post-capture crop and retake controls; current camera flow only captures or uploads and immediately analyzes.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True; configure explicit origins for secure authenticated deployments.
PRD lists crop/retake as backlog although both are explicit requested camera requirements.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary uniquely named test accounts and scans; no seeded account or production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests passed. Browser tests passed after saving an allergy before scanning: food profile match, history search/open, profile save, and medicine disclaimer. Camera permission denial/upload fallback and delete confirmation remain untested in browser.
rca of the issue: The API client hardcodes a Vite-specific environment key, while the project contract supplies REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Same-origin development proxy hides the mismatch. Camera capture sets the file and exits camera mode without an intermediate editing state, so crop/retake cannot be performed.
